listing.name: Bejeweled Blitz Live — Re-Jeweled (thefixinhixon)
listing.summary: The project describes test build1b as playable. Full mode coverage is unknown. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Bejeweled Blitz Live Xbox 360 XBLA package or its complete extracted files. Title 58410A57; Default.xex and documented PAK files.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the Linux test package’s launcher to import your own Bejeweled Blitz LIVE default.xex and PAK files.
